project_name: GRR-01 Reference Project (Part A - physical infrastructure)
notes: Declared train paths of the GRR-01 reference railway, kept in a companion file.
examples/GRR-01.json stays frozen and declares train_paths.paths == [] itself.
A path is data of the Phase-4A interchange form: {id, edges: [{edge_id, traversal}]}.

Selection rule (stated verbatim): Start candidates: every edge of the frozen project on which an Alpha station platform is declared (platform.track_id). End candidates: every edge on which a Delta station platform is declared. Among all Alpha -> Delta walks of the frozen graph whose first edge is a Start candidate and whose last edge is an End candidate, choose (a) the walk of minimum total length_m, then (b) the walk of minimum edge count, then (c) the walk whose ordered edge-id list is lexicographically smallest.

The rule selects exactly one walk: 14 edges, 47 400.0 m, from the Alpha P2 platform edge (PLT-ALP-P2 on TR-A-E1-E) through the Central P4 platform road (PLT-CEN-P4 on TR-C-P4) and the Valley through road (TR-V-THRU2) to the Delta P1 platform edge (PLT-DEL-P1 on TR-D-P1); the Alpha P1 alternative is 1 600 m longer.

PATH-H1-F is that walk W, declared in its travel order; PATH-H1-R is reverse(W): the same edge entries in reverse order with the complementary traversal (WITH_EDGE <-> AGAINST_EDGE). The two paths are one physical corridor run in opposite directions.
Every edge id and every traversal is derived from the frozen project's own track endpoints; no traversal is hand-typed, and this file is never merged into GRR-01.
No project key, value, count or rule of the frozen project is changed by this file.

paths.name: GRR-01 reference running path, Alpha -> Delta (forward order)
paths.description: Alpha P2 platform edge (declared reference forward origin, PLT-ALP-P2) through Central P4 and Valley THRU2 to the Delta P1 platform edge (PLT-DEL-P1), in forward running order.

paths.name: GRR-01 reference running path, Delta -> Alpha (reverse order)
paths.description: The same physical corridor as PATH-H1-F, run from the Delta P1 platform edge (declared reference reverse origin, PLT-DEL-P1) back to the Alpha P2 platform edge, in reverse running order.
